intro.text: A humanlike people with feathers in place of hair; ZeetZi of the Dynamic is one.
A humanlike people with feathers instead of hair, from the Grand Apparatus, whom others tend to avoid for their foreign policy and their ties to the Sleepless.

description.text: They descend from humans whose hair, after a long isolation, turned into something like feathers.
Contrary to popular belief, arcanists have found that lawnarks are not descended from birds, and they cannot fly.

They look almost exactly like humans. Their scalps are largely bare apart from a crest of feathers on top, tiny, nearly invisible feathers grow on their arms, and some have dark brown skin. A worried lawnark's feathers often flatten against the head.
